physicalEvidence.summary: The real Stretch RE2 experiment was already present in the December 12, 2023 first preprint, later published January 27, 2025 in npj Robotics. A personalized feedforward decoder with two512-node hidden layers classifies10gestures from 64-electrode EMG, driving8-DOF mobile manipulation through conventional PID control with 13participants. This is learned-input teleoperation, not autonomous task planning. Calibration/recalibration and clinical generalization remain limitations. Current CMU and lead-author rosters independently confirm Weber/Erickson co-advising; they do not turn the 2023 experiment into new 2025/2026 execution. Physical20 reflects older verified hardware.
